Medi Claim Policy
Dabbawalas have to work hard to ensure that the right tiffin box reach the right customer at right time. This job involves working in all weather conditions like high rain, cold and extreme summer. Due to this, the chance of falling sick increases tremendously. In case of high medical and hospitalization bill, the financial condition of Dabbawala is severely affected.

In order to sort out this problem, Dabbawala Enterprises Private Limited offers Rs. 100,000 (1 Lakhs) medi claim policy to Dabbawalas covering their entire family. This ensures that in the unfortunate event of falling sick or hospitalization, the Dabbawalas are financially secured.

Welfare of Dabbawalas
Insurance
The job of collecting and delivering Tiffin Boxes is a highly risky endeavor undertaken by Dabbawala. Every year thousands of people die on the tracks of Mumbai local trains. In the unfortunate incident of accident of Dabbawala, their families have to undergo an extreme financial hardship which devastates them financially.

In order to sort out this problem, Dabbawala Enterprises Private Limited offers RS. 10,00,000 (10 Lakhs) insurance policy to Dabbawalas. This ensures that in the unfortunate event of an accident, the families of Dabbawalas are financially secured.

I was wanting to try this home made meal from a long time and finally could manage to try it last night. The team is very courteous and eager to ensure a pleasant food experience. The meal which is priced quite economically at 120rs inclusive of home delivery charges comes in plastic containers and rotis in safe and nice packing. featured_reviews.review_text:
I came across Sunita's Tiffin Services while looking for a good, home cooked meal delivery service that can deliver meals in and around Chembur, Kurla East, Chunabhatti. I was looking for home cooked meals for dinner as I wanted to avoid the hassle of making meals post 9 P.M. or eating random food from hotels.

I've been availing their services since June 2024 and am a delighted customer.

They have meals labelled regular (large portions) and mini (standard portions). The meals come with a Sabzi, a Dal, Rotis and Rice. You can get extra Rotis instead of the rice or vice versa as they are open to customising. Their food is home made, light on the stomach, and tastes wonderful. The team juggles their sabzis and dals everyday offering the consumer lots of variety.

They deliver lunch and dinner at the doorstep with the help of a great group of delivery personnel.

I can't praise them enough. Great food, great service and a delight!

As a Customer, I feel pretty trusted to buy more products from them in the future. And as a Marketer : 10/10 on the Brand overall! ⭐️🔥

featured_reviews.review_text:
Quality and taste are guaranteed here which we realised every time we ordered. We can feel the freshness and homely fragrance in the food. Appreciate their professional handing of orders and prompt delivery boys.
We can have 100% Trust for Quality.
Rice quality should be increased as we being rice eaters! But no complaints. Great service they are doing at a highly reasonable price. Once you order, you will become regular for sure👍 Good Luck to Bhojanyan Team🌟

featured_reviews.name: Ameet Kumar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Food: 5/5
Price: 4/5
Service: 5/5
Staff Behavior: 5/5

Yes ofcourse they really mean what they say.. Maa ke hat ka khana.
The food, packaging, hygiene everything is taken care of to the best. Like mother they remind you to order food even if you forget any day.
The main concern for many people about this kind of tiffin services is the hygiene level at food preparation place. I personally visited their kitchen and believe me it is very neat & clean. I have tried many other food services but here the food is the best as per the quality & quantity. As per the price also it is quite decent. You can subscribe for their regular meal for just INR 100/-. Other premium items may seem to be bit pricy but quality justify the price.
Thank you Team Bhojanayan for serving delicious yet healthy food to many people like me who are far from their home. Thank you for delivering me food even after placing order after 9pm which is usually your closing hours.
I wish the whole team good luck. Keep growing and expand your business to more area so that more people get your service, All the best.

featured_reviews.name: kamal bhatia
featured_reviews.review_text:
As someone from Delhi who can't compromise on food quality and taste, Jasbir Tiffin has been nothing short of a blessing. Aunty's meals are filled with love and the authentic flavours that remind me of my mom's cooking back home.

After a long, exhausting day at work that often leaves you drained, Aunty's food does more than just fill your stomach—it revives your spirit.

I salute Aunty for bringing the taste of my home to Mumbai, ensuring that no matter how far away I am, I always have a little piece of Delhi with me. Thank you, Jasbir Tiffin, for being more than just a tiffin service—you've become a part of my daily life that I deeply value and appreciate.

Highly recommended for anyone craving that home-cooked goodness! 🍽️❤️

featured_reviews.name: Satish Sudarsan
featured_reviews.review_text:
I started lunch & dinner from Jasbir Tiffin Service almost a month back because I was not happy with my Marathi cook's food.
I am extremely happy with the food being provided which is not only tasty, but homely as well.
The best part for me is the huge variety of dishes both veg and non-veg and nothing is repeated.
Fantastic food service.
Thank you Jasbirji. I am truly a fan of your cooking.

featured_reviews.name: rajan sabhani
featured_reviews.review_text: Have been getting food from Jasbir for the last week. For once it feels as though the food has been cooked in my own kitchen. Every daal has a distinctive flavour and taste and the vegetables too are cooked in minimum oil and taste really good. The best part of the meal are the awesome chapattis which are soft and fresh. I would recommend this tiffin to anyone who wants typical home cooked, hygienic food! !

featured_reviews.name: N B
featured_reviews.review_text: Food is very tasty. Mrs. Jasbir's nature is good and cordial. Punjabi food is served. Quantity and quality both r good. Reasonable price. Good service. Professional attitude.Nonoily, nonspicy healthy food. We r happy and satisfied. God bless her and her family. 👍
